If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in

the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Delivery Location: Delivery shall be made across Rajasthan at all 41 District Headquarters at no additi onal cost (inclusive of freight charges). The bidder must have an established after-sales service facility at every delivery location. Exact details of each delivery point and the corresponding quantities will be c ommunicated at the time of placing the Purchase/Supply Order. 2. Phased Supply: The scooters will be distributed to the beneficiaries (female students) in phases; accor dingly, Purchase/Supply orders will also be placed in phases as per departmental requirement. The qualif ied bidder must ensure that the scooters are delivered within 100 days from the issuance of the Supply/ Purchase Order. 3. Registration and Insurance: The successful bidder shall be solely responsible for registering each sco oter in the name of the respective beneficiary (female students), arranging insurance (1-year comprehe nsive + 4-year third-party), and fulfilling all other applicable statutory requirements as per extant rules. No additional charges shall be payable for these services. 4. Items to be Supplied with Each Scooter (at no additional cost): One ISI-marked helmet, two liters of petrol, and all essential accessories like guard kit, grip cover, kick rubber, seat cover, side stand, floor mat, saree guard/step set, etc. 5. Estimated Quantity: The bid quantity is purely indicative. The actual quantity to be supplied—either at individual delivery locations or collectively—may vary depending on administrative requirements and exi gencies. 6. CMVR Compliance: Along with the offer, the bidder must submit valid Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) certification for the quoted item, in accordance with extant rules. 7. Statutory Documents: The bidder must submit valid copies of their GST registration certificate and PA

N/TIN along with the offer. 8. Distribution Mechanism: Scooters will be distributed to beneficiaries through the IFMS-based e-vouch er system. 9. Scooter Distribution and Payment Process: The Department shall issue vouchers to eligible female students. Each student shall visit an authorized OEM dealer to select a scooter and redeem her voucher. Within 15 days of voucher redemption, the dealer shall register the scooter in the student’s name, arran ge insurance, complete all other formalities mandated under the tender, and deliver the vehicle to the s tudent. Upon delivery, the dealer shall raise an invoice for the scooter on the Integrated Financial Manag ement System (IFMS) along with all required supporting documents. Following certification of the invoice by the concerned Officer/Principal, the bill shall be forwarded to the Treasury, and payment shall be rele ased through IFMS within 45 days. Detailed operational guidelines shall be shared with the selected bidd er(s). 10. Allotment Criteria: Scooters shall be allotted to eligible beneficiaries (female students) on a first-come, first-served basis. 11. Splitting of tender quantity: To ensure smooth supply, effort will be made to split the tendered quan tity among 3 bidders in the ratio of 50:30:20 respectively after the Buyer have ensured that the L-1 pric e is reasonable. 50% of tendered quantity will be awarded to L1 (lowest) bidder and balance 50% of ten der quantity will be given to other qualified bidders in the ratio of 30:20 in order of their ranking (L-2 and L-3) subject to matching of L1 bidder’s rate. The counter-offer to match the L-1 rate shall be extended to all qualified bidders. If any subsequent bidder declines to match the L-1 rate for the split share, the rem aining quantity shall be redistributed among the L-1 bidder and the bidder who have accepted the L-1 ra te, in proportion to their originally allocated quantities. If only two bidders are qualified, the quantity sha ll be split between them in the same proportion (50:30) (62.50% and 37.50%. of 88000) If none of the ot her qualified bidders agree to match the L-1 rate, the contract for 100% of the quantity shall be awarded to the L-1 bidder. 12. Extension of Delivery Period: The Buyer may re-fix the original Delivery Period without imposing Liqui dated Damages, subject to Force Majeure conditions specified in the GTC, or in instances where the dela y is directly attributable to the Buyer or Consignee. 13. Urgency of Supply: This is an urgent procurement; all supplies must be completed strictly within the stipulated bid delivery period. 14. Liquidated Damages: If the Seller/Service Provider fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Services with in the original or re-fixed delivery period specified in the contract, the Buyer shall be entitled to deduct or recover Liquidated Damages for the delay in accordance with applicable rules and the GTC, unless th e delay is covered under Force Majeure. 15. Breach and Cancellation: Failure by the Seller to fulfill their obligations within the contractual Delivery Period/Date shall constitute a breach of contract. Consequently, the Buyer reserves the right to cancel o r withdraw the contract for the unsupplied portion upon the expiry of the original, extended, or re-fixed delivery period. 16. Bid Security Exemption: Exemption from Bid Security (Earnest Money Deposit / EMD) shall be granted to eligible sellers in accordance with extant rules. Sellers claiming such exemption must upload valid sup porting documents or certificates along with their offer; failing which, the exemption claim shall not be a dmissible, and the bid shall be summarily rejected for non-submission of Bid Security.

17. Bid Security submitted by the bidder shall be forfeited, if the bidder: i. Withdraws or modify or impairs or derogates from the bid in any respect within the period of validity of its bid; or ii. If it comes to notice that the information / documents furnished in its bid is false, misleading or forged ; or iii. Fails to furnish requisite performance security within stipulated time required as per e-bid / RA conditi ons. 18. Performance Security: The successful bidder shall deposit a Performance Security of3 % of the contr act value. 19. Forfeiture and Penalties: Cancellation on account of non-performance shall entitle the Buyer to forfeit the Performance Security, in addition to initiating other penal actions such as downgrading the Seller's r ating or debarment from GeM for a specified period, as decided by GeM on the merits of the case. 20. Upload Manufacturer authorization: Wherever Authorised Distributors are submitting the bid, Manufa cturers Authorisation Form (MAF)/Certificate with OEM details such as name, designation, address, e-mai l Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid. 21. Warranty Support and Repair Services: The selected bidder(s) shall provide comprehensive OEM wa rranty support and vehicle repair services through designated service support centres across all 41 distri cts of Rajasthan. 22. District-Level Service Network: The selected bidder(s) shall ensure the availability of authorized servi ce support centres in every district to fulfill all OEM warranty obligations. 23. Availability of Spare Parts: The selected bidder shall be responsible to ensure adequate and timely av ailability of spare parts needed for repairing the supplied scooters at the service support centres during the warranty period. 24. Pre-Delivery Inspection and Quality Assurance: The selected bidder shall be liable for conducting qu ality inspection and testing and ensure that there should not be any physical damage(s) and shall contai n all the required accessories before declaring the scooters ready for delivery. 25. Branding and Customization Artwork: The logo & message matter shall be provided by buyer at the t ime of work order. 26. Legal Entity and Eligibility: The bidder must be a proprietorship firm or company or partnership firm (J oint venture not allowed) – Copy of registration under Rajasthan Shops and Commercial Establishment A ct 1958 or Company Act 1956/2013 or the Indian Partnership Act 1932. 27. Right to Accept or Reject Bids: The tendering authority reserves the right to accept or reject any bid and to cancel the bidding process and reject all bids at any time prior to contract award without thereby incurring any liability to the bidder. 28. Repudiation / Termination of Contract: The contract for the supply can be repudiated at any time by the purchase officer, if the supplies are not made to his satisfaction after giving an opportunity of being heard to the bidder and recording the reasons for repudiation. 29. Withholding and Recovery of Dues: The purchase officer shall withhold amount to the extent of short supply, liquidated damages, broken/damaged or rejected articles and recovered from his dues and perfo rmance security deposit. The balance, if any, shall be demanded from the selected bidder and when reco very is not possible, the purchase officer shall take recourse of law in force.

30. Prohibition on Assignment and Sub-letting: The bidder shall not assign or sub-let his contract or any substantial part thereof to any other agency during the contract period. 31. Pre-Bid Meeting : A pre-bid meeting will be held on November 30, 2026, at 15:00 hrs at the Office of th e Commissioner, College Education Department, Rajasthan, Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Shiksha Sankul, JLN Ma rg, Jaipur (Rajasthan). Interested bidders are requested to attend on time. 32. Precedence of Terms: In the event of any conflict between provisions, the Terms and Conditions stipul ated in the Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) shall supersede those in the General Terms and Cond itions (GTC) and Special Terms and Conditions (STC). 33. Bid Submission: Bidders are advised to read the entire bid document, including all the aforementioned terms and conditions, carefully before participating and attach bidder comliance performa along with the offer. Financial bids must be quoted after accounting for all requirements specified in the bid. . 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 11.
